name: Manual Shell Extraction
aliases: Manual Shell Extraction — Connected Component Separation, Disjoint Mesh Isolation, Shell Extraction via Manual Traversal, findShell
definition: Separates a polygonal isosurface mesh into connected components (shells) to handle disjoint surfaces or allow user selection of specific regions.
summary: Manual Shell Extraction separates a polygonal isosurface mesh into connected components by explicitly traversing the mesh graph from a starting triangle, enabling interactive selection of disjoint regions.
